evidence.summary: Report selector shows Daily sales and Open report. Caption explicitly instructs this choice.
Start date 05/01/2026 and End date 05/31/2026; Include refunds checked. Caption calls dates requested period and says usual refunds choice.
Daily sales result, May 1–May 31 2026, USD, Includes refunds; rows May1 $125.00/5 and May31 $240.00/8. Caption requires checking title/dates/USD before export.
Export CSV followed by CSV prepared marker. Caption says newly requested dates for next period and ask whether refunds policy changes.

claims.statement: The demonstrated report is Daily sales.
The example period is May1–May31 2026 and next runs use newly requested dates.
Include refunds is checked in this demonstration.
Keeping refunds enabled may match the usual choice, but a general business rule was not demonstrated.
The visible training account/company labels do not prove authenticated business identity.
The displayed example includes rows on both requested boundaries; future portal timezone/end-boundary semantics need verification.

parameters.meaning: Requested beginning of report period, not a fixed recorded date.
Requested end of report period; confirm boundary/timezone before consequential reuse.
Observed true; future policy is unresolved rather than silently fixed.

states.description: Reports heading, Report selector and Open report button.
Daily sales heading, date fields, Include refunds checkbox and Run report button.
Daily sales title with date-range/currency summary and dated result rows.
CSV prepared marker; file content still needs verification.

routines.goal: Select Daily sales in the intended verified business context.
preconditions: Freshly verify intended account/company through existing SiteGuide/Auth predicates; a visible label alone is insufficient.

steps.description: Identify the Reports page and exact Daily sales option.

branches.condition: Authentication or business context cannot be independently verified
branches.next: Request existing native human/Auth assistance before report actions.

outcomes.verification: Observe title plus date fields and Run report, without assuming click acknowledgement proves navigation.

recovery.condition: Expected report selection or controls are missing
recovery.next: Stop with adaptation required; inspect current page rather than guess coordinates.

routines.goal: Apply caller dates and an explicitly settled refunds choice.
preconditions: Dates supplied by caller and valid ordered ISO dates.
Future refunds policy resolved before execution.

steps.description: Apply explicit reviewed refunds parameter; demonstration showed true.

branches.next: Ask focused question about future refunds policy; do not re-ask visible recorded checkbox value.

outcomes.description: Requested parameters are visible in controls.
outcomes.verification: Read back start/end and checkbox before submitting.

recovery.condition: A date or checkbox cannot be verified
recovery.next: Do not submit; request clarification or adapt the exact changed control.

routines.goal: Generate the report and verify its context before export.
preconditions: Inputs independently read back and business context verified.

steps.description: Run report once under existing operation custody.
Verify Daily sales title, requested range, USD and refunds status.

branches.condition: Empty report or missing currency/range metadata
branches.next: Return explicit empty/intervention result; the demonstration does not establish empty-report policy.

outcomes.description: Report content corresponds to the requested period and currency.
outcomes.verification: Check displayed report identity/range and independently inspect row dates; the example shows May1 and May31.

recovery.next: Inspect original operation and visible report before any new submit; never replay merely to discover its outcome.

routines.goal: Export CSV and verify the resulting artifact rather than the click.

steps.description: Request CSV export once with retained original operation identity.
Inspect artifact report identity, date column, numeric USD values and requested boundaries.

branches.condition: Only CSV prepared or file event exists
branches.next: Treat artifact verification as pending; do not report successful reusable report yet.

outcomes.description: A correct CSV artifact is independently verified.
outcomes.verification: Check CSV columns and date bounds against the request; recorded example rows show 2026-05-01/125.00/5 and 2026-05-31/240.00/8.

recovery.condition: Export reply is lost or file cannot be attributed
recovery.next: Retain original uncertain export operation, inspect artifact references, and request assistance if still ambiguous; no blind duplicate export.

playbook.goal: Produce an independently verified Daily sales CSV for caller-selected dates.
playbook.completionVerification: Exact intended account/company, Daily sales report, requested date range, USD/refunds semantics and attributed CSV rows are independently verified.

unresolved.question: Should future runs always include refunds, or should the caller choose per report?
unresolved.interpretation: The observed demonstration includes refunds. Recommend exposing includeRefunds explicitly until business policy is confirmed.

unresolved.question: Which reporting timezone and inclusive end-date rule govern new periods?
unresolved.interpretation: Example output visibly contains both boundary dates; do not infer every future timezone or portal rule.

limitations: Caption-led synthetic A/V uses a reference tone, not spoken narration or an ASR transcript.
Role/accessible-name locators are inferred from visible labels and must be checked against the live page.
Draft only: no execution or publication approval; actual operator narration/recognition and real portal repeat are separate qualification.
